title: Romania’s Mangalia shipyard sold to Rheinmetall for EUR 138 mln
summary: Damen Shipyards Mangalia has been sold to Rheinmetall Real Estate Romania for EUR 138.03 million, excluding VAT, judicial liquidator CITR announced on Friday, October 9. The company won the auction conducted as part of the shipyard’s insolvency proceedings. CITR said the transaction could allow operations to resume at the shipyard, which it described as one of Romania’s most important industrial assets. “The sale concludes a complex asset-valuation process intended to ensure operational continuity and provide an encouraging outlook for the future,” said CITR CEO Paul Dieter Cîrlănaru. title: Pentagon vows to livestream first military execution in decades
summary: The first US military execution in more than 65 years will be livestreamed, announced the Pentagon on Thursday, after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said it would be "public". Former Army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan opened fire at Fort Hood in Texas in 2009, killing 13 people. His execution will take place at the military base on December 3, 2026. "The livestreaming of an execution is tantamount to a public execution and would breach the absolute prohibition of torture," the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights said on Friday.
